reviewObservations: The corrected IFF archive URL identifies Estonia’s floorball association. Its linked official championship story establishes organized Estonian competitions; the independently read article says Sparta won both2023 categories and defeated Jõgeva in the men’s fifth final. The earlier inaccurate proposal note was corrected before the approved SHA was frozen.

IFF’s official overview describes team play, shoes, lightweight sticks and a board-enclosed rink; its official learning PDF describes the hollow perforated plastic ball. These primary descriptions support the unchanged Floorball/Saalihoki identification and explanation.

Apple121877 explicitly establishes that bought digital media may be downloaded to compatible devices and accessed offline. This supports the unchanged Digital download/Digitaalne allalaadimine question and explanation. Apple118239 currently covers subscription/channel media rather than directly establishing the purchased-media premise.

The two complete categories retain distinct targets: floorball, Paul Keres, Novuss, Kurn and Brus; multiplex, matinee, digital download, Fritz Lang and Jean-Pierre Melville. The revised citations add no public wording, answer hint or sibling dependency. All IDs, membership, tiers, difficulty, enabled state and bilingual prose remain unchanged.

The Floorball/Saalihoki prompts preserve the same physical identifying clues. The English prompt additionally mentions national leagues, while Estonian already asks about the sport played in Estonia; this unchanged secondary context does not change the answer or introduce a new translation regression.

IFF’s current footer credits its copyright to IFF. No open reuse licence was found on the inspected archive/current pages; the retained all-rights-reserved label is conservative existing metadata, not a new express grant inferred from its privacy policy.

Apple’s own website terms establish copyright control and restrictions on republication/distribution. The retained Proprietary; citation-only label records proprietary status and existing citation practice; citation-only is a use description and is not a licence grant. No new permission to reproduce Apple text/media is claimed.

Exact in-memory raw-record replacement reproduces allsix proposed fileAfterSha256 values. Record comparison confirms only citation title/URL/retrieval metadata change; source licences, sourceIds, provenance and historical review objects remain intact.
